text:
Abstract
This query asked which experimental platform and organism are associated with GEO Series GSE309890. To answer, we retrieved metadata from NCBI GEO using the geo_series tool for both the Series (GSE309890) and its linked Platform (GPL24659). No filters beyond the accession identifiers were applied. The GSE309890 record reports the platform as GPL24659 and the organism as Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655. The linked platform record (GPL24659) identifies the instrument title as “Illumina HiSeq 4000 (Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655).” Key numbers from the Series include sample_count = 6; the platform itself carries sample_count = 460 across GEO, which confirms its use history but is not specific to this Series. The result matters for data reuse and interpretation: knowing the sequencing instrument and organism allows appropriate downstream analyses (e.g., mapping to the correct reference, quality expectations, and relevant annotation resources). All values and URLs are directly traced to GEO’s Entrez Summary responses and GEO record pages.

I. Introduction
Background. GEO Series records describe gene expression studies and link to the sequencing platform used and the organism studied. Identifying the platform and organism for a specific Series is necessary for correct downstream bioinformatics processing.
Literature Review. No literature was retrieved for this query.
Knowledge Gap. The platform and organism for GSE309890 were not specified in the question and needed verification from the authoritative record.
Objective & Hypothesis. Objective: Identify the platform and organism for GSE309890 from GEO metadata. Hypothesis: GEO Series metadata contains fields that explicitly name both the platform accession and the organism.

II. Materials and Methods
Study Design. We queried NCBI GEO to retrieve the Series metadata for GSE309890 and then resolved the linked platform (GPL24659) to obtain the instrument title. GEO is the authoritative repository for these fields.
Materials.
- NCBI GEO (functions.geo_series) for Series and Platform metadata.
Procedures.
1) functions.geo_series with arguments: {"accession": "GSE309890", "list_files": true}.
2) functions.geo_series with arguments: {"accession": "GPL24659", "list_files": true}.
Statistical Analysis. Counts were taken directly from returned fields: sample_count from the Series record (6) and platform sample_count from the Platform record (460). No deduplication was needed; values are single-source fields in GEO summaries. The platform accession (platform) and organism name (taxon) were read verbatim from the Series record; instrument title came from the Platform record title.

III. Results
Data Presentation. (Table 1)

| Field | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Series accession | GSE309890 | GEO Series record |
| Platform accession | GPL24659 | GEO Series record |
| Platform title | Illumina HiSeq 4000 (Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655) | GEO Platform record |
| Organism (taxon) | Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 | GEO Series record |
| Series sample_count | 6 | GEO Series record |
| Platform sample_count | 460 | GEO Platform record |

Findings.
- GSE309890 platform: GPL24659.
- Platform instrument: Illumina HiSeq 4000.
- Organism: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655.
- GSE309890 sample_count: 6.
- GPL24659 sample_count across GEO: 460.

IV. Discussion
Interpretation. The GEO Series metadata state that GSE309890 used platform GPL24659, which is an Illumina HiSeq 4000 instrument, and the organism studied is E. coli K-12 MG1655. This meets the objective.
Context. The Series record directly reports platform accession and organism; the Platform record provides the human-readable instrument title, consistent with the organism designation.
Limitations. GEO’s Entrez summary provides metadata only; processed expression matrices are available in supplementary files on GEO FTP. No PubMed link is registered for GSE309890 or GPL24659 in GEO at the time of retrieval, which limits cross-referencing to publications.
Conclusion & Future Directions. GSE309890 was run on Illumina HiSeq 4000 (GPL24659) and studies Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655. Future queries could retrieve and analyze the supplementary expression files or cross-link any later-added PubMed records.

References
[1] NCBI GEO Series: GSE309890. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890
[2] NCBI GEO Platform: GPL24659. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GPL24659

Acknowledgments
We acknowledge NCBI GEO for providing Series and Platform metadata and file links.
